verdict.rationale: A game engine's editor could plausibly ship an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Unreal Engine connecting to or consuming external MCP servers' tools. The probe found no official Epic MCP work at all, and the community MCP projects it mentions expose Unreal to outside agents, which is the opposite direction. Python scripting, plugins and the Remote Control API are developer building blocks for constructing such a feature, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
